children: Apple is expanding its American Manufacturing Program to boost U.S. domestic supply of components for the company's iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro.

The company said Tuesday that it will commit up to $100 million over three years with the Pennsylvania-based titanium producer Perryman Co., which will supply titanium for Apple products including the Duo, Apple's first foldable phone.
Apple will also expand its partnership with Delaware-based Qnity Electronics to produce components for the iPhone 18 Pro's camera system.

"American ingenuity is vital to all our products, from the titanium crafted for iPhone Duo to breakthrough camera innovations in iPhone 18 Pro," Chief Operating Officer Sabih Khan said. "We're proud to work with Perryman and Qnity Electronics to continue expanding our American Manufacturing Program and support U.S. jobs."
